_description: Log of all processed Azure Boards tickets with summaries and extracted context

tickets.title: Send Shoppix.me email at 1pm the day after registration
tickets.summary: Auto-assign Shoppix.me email during registration. Send scheduled notification at 1pm next day. No 50-token bonus for auto-assigned emails. PR #1390 implements changes in CreateProfileCommandHandler with ActiveSubmission email assignment, service bus messaging, and DST-aware scheduling.

tickets.title: Android Rewards Migration: My Vouchers || UI Design and API Integration
tickets.summary: My Vouchers migration for the rewards module in Jetpack Compose. The ticket introduces a voucher list screen plus voucher detail screens for PayPal and Amazon.co.uk, with data binding for voucher amount, redemption date, registered Shoppix email, order reference copying, and a Go to my voucher CTA on applicable vouchers.

tickets.title: Improve Notification Messaging to Increase User Understanding, Compliance, and Retention
tickets.summary: Comprehensive redesign of 26+ notification types across Compliance, Duplicate Receipt, E-receipt, Rewards, Scratchcard, Survey, and Account categories. Changes include new user-centric wording with emojis, dynamic variables ({tokens}, {days}, {email}, {minutes}, {X}, {0}, {1}), updated CTA buttons (Snap now, Learn more, Forward my receipt, Scratch now, Start now, See your balance, View voucher, View details, Learn how), new/changed deep links, updated placement (Lock Screen added for many), removed impossible CTAs for receipts never created, and category-specific icon system. Backend changes span Morpheus.Messaging, Receipt service, Survey service, and Notification service."

tickets.title: Android: Account Deactivation and Deletion Issue
tickets.summary: Facebook-created Shoppix accounts must support both account deactivation and deletion. Coverage includes success flows, no-local-password path, account_state propagation, downstream service bus cleanup, network resilience, idempotency, cross-device propagation after deletion, and accessibility of the confirmation dialogs.

tickets.title: Remove 50 tokens for choosing Shoppix.me email address
tickets.summary: Mandatory Shoppix.me email assignment should no longer grant the legacy 50-token reward. The ticket focuses on suppressing the reward during registration, ensuring no balance bump, no transaction entry, and no reward notification while keeping unrelated rewards intact.

tickets.title: SHOPPIX-55 - Disable Launch button for Surveys
tickets.summary: Expanded Manage Shoppix survey lifecycle coverage based on the screenshot: add survey, validate a unique Tivian survey ID, enter tokens and expiry date/time, refresh surveys, refresh users, launch survey, and confirm the survey appears in the Shoppix app. The original Launch button gating rule still applies: enable only for Created and UserListRefreshed.

tickets.title: Notification Bell Icon Coverage (ad-hoc)
tickets.summary: Standalone coverage for the notification bell icon in the Shoppix app header: visibility for logged-in users, unread badge behavior, tap navigation to the Notification Centre, empty and error state handling, offline behavior, accessibility, visual rendering, and regression around deep-link entries.

tickets.title: Changes for notifications
tickets.summary: Pending Figma-derived test cases for the Notification Centre and bell icon flow: empty and error state visuals and CTAs (Start snapping / Try again), per-category icon color mapping across 11 categories, dynamic placeholder resolution and fallbacks, singular/plural handling for scratchcards, complete CTA-to-destination matrix, Nulink and Receipt-approved retry variants, screen header text and structural details (clock icon, full-width CTA, card styling), and safeguards against design placeholders leaking to production.

tickets.title: Passive collection Doc
tickets.summary: Backend design document (Passive-Collection.pdf, 19 pages) attached to a Product Backlog Item. Defines the Passive Collection feature: connecting IMAP mailboxes (Gmail/Yahoo/Outlook), on-device scanning against reused GET /user/inbox-filters, per-user decisions (Selected/Declined/Unavailable), raw-MIME submission to per-user blob container with 90-day SAS, outbox handoff to the receipt service via passivesubmission queue, multi-device behaviour, and account/dropout cleanup via useraccountstatusupdated topic. Ticket has no description, AC, comments, or PRs — the PDF is the sole source. QA flow document and 80 test cases were generated; document flags 2 CRITICAL doc bugs (per-user blob container is destroyed on single-account scope=all delete; contradictory 400 vs 409 for EMAIL_ALREADY_CONNECTED_ON_DEVICE), 3 HIGH issues (EmailUid semantics vs Message-ID width, concurrent PATCH race, no batch/body size limits), and several MEDIUM/LOW issues.

tickets.title: Handle messages in transcriptioncomplete queue
tickets.summary: Tickets 214410 (parent PBL 'Handle messages in transcriptioncomplete queue') and 215238 (Stage Testing Receipt): add per-field DB-constraint handling in the transcriptioncomplete flow. NullIfExceedsMaxLength for string fields and TruncateToDecimalPlaces for decimals (2 places for money fields, 3 for Volume). Receipt must still process on overflow. ReceiptHeader/ReceiptFooter and several line fields removed from the contract (PR 1980). Generated 46 test cases (Functional 32, Edge 5, Integration 5, Regression 4) exported with 4 columns only.

tickets.title: Waitlist
tickets.summary: Deep-link validation for waiting-list invitation URLs when users report 'Please use a valid invitation link' on valid or appended invite links. Focused on whether the app accepts the standard invitation pattern and common appended URL parts without surfacing the invalid-link error.
